name: Sanguine Keep
author: kolache
description: A moonlit gothic castle: crimson velvet, cold stone and gilt reliquary frames by night, pale marble and clear-glass daylight by day. Portraits sit in lancet windows and every message is a cut-cornered reliquary panel.

credits.what: Fonts: Crimson Pro, Cinzel, Pirata One

fonts.credit: Crimson Pro by Jacques Le Bailly
Pirata One by Rodrigo Fuenzalida and Nicolas Massi
